# Tender response -- KESKIJKAU-2026-0143

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical property maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy confirms it meets all eligibility requirements set out in Section 3 of this notice.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Corrective maintenance response times: critical faults attended within 4 hours of report, non-critical faults within 24 hours.

4.2 Refrigeration and cooling-plant servicing is delivered by our F-kaasu certified technicians in accordance with the F-gas regulation, with logged checks at required intervals.

4.3 Subcontracted work is governed by a management plan covering subcontractor approval, insurance and qualification verification, and retained supervisory responsibility with Visakoivu's own site lead.

4.4 The property asset register and associated maintenance documentation are handed over to the City in an agreed digital format at contract end or on request during the term.

4.5 We propose SLA targets of 95% of critical faults resolved within the response window, reported monthly with root-cause notes where a target is missed.

4.6 New or modified plant is commissioned against a written test protocol witnessed by the City's property management unit.

4.7 Condition-monitoring data is collected via our maintenance management system and made available to the City on request.

4.8 All deployed technicians hold the qualifications required for their trade and carry evidence on site.

4.9 Our staff observe the City's access-control and site-security procedures at each property, including sign-in and identification.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Pricing is quoted in EUR.

5.2 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency where subcontracted work forms part of an invoice.

5.3 A cost breakdown is provided in accordance with the required format.

5.4 We accept a contractual penalty for service levels not met, calculated against the affected call-off order.

## 6. Forms and attachments

6.1 CVs of key personnel are enclosed.

## 7. Submission format

7.2 All prices are rounded to two decimal places.

7.3 The framework pricing reference currency is EUR.

7.4 This tender is submitted ahead of the deadline of 19 October 2026, 12:00 EET.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 Proposed energy-efficiency measures include monitoring of HVAC run-times against occupancy schedules and flagging plant operating outside expected efficiency bands for corrective action.

2.2 Unresolved faults are escalated to a named supervisor after 24 hours and to management after 48 hours, with the City kept informed.

3.2 Visakoivu operates round-the-clock (24/7) fault-response duty within Finland, drawing on standby arrangements already in place under our current public-sector maintenance agreements (including the framework for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue's five terveysasemat). This will be extended to cover the present framework.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 The applicable retention percentage is confirmed in the pricing schedule.

2.2 This tender is submitted using the required tender form (Liite 1), completed in full.
